target_candidate.pmt_type: pending: WCTE config names no PMT hardware model

stage_owners.timing_width: readout split-normal digit kernel (thesis Eq. 6.3; sigma_e early, sigma_l late) with a per-module factor scaling both sigmas; upstream TTS forbidden
stage_owners.dark_counts: readout (R-6): keyed Poisson dark photoelectrons per PMT, uniform in readout_window_ns, bypass QE/CE, then the same SPE charge, gain, discriminator, T-Q walk and width

transport.spectrum: fixture: uniform 300..600 nm synthetic, not Cherenkov; LUCiD pilots: PhotonSim Cherenkov photons in the 200..800 nm QE band

conventions.gain: dimensionless multiplier after PE detection and SPE smearing
conventions.timing: forward ns; D-TQ walk(q)=a+b/sqrt(min(q,q_sat)) on the charge domain; frozen reference subtraction; digit width is the split-normal kernel of Eq. 6.3 with density sqrt(2/pi)/(sigma_e+sigma_l)*exp(-(t-t0)^2/(2 sigma^2)), sigma=sigma_e for t < t0 (early) and sigma=sigma_l for t >= t0 (late), mode t0 = photon arrival + walk, sigma_e/sigma_l from the charge table interpolated linearly in log10 q; sampled mean = t0 + sqrt(2/pi)*(sigma_l - sigma_e); digits earlier than photon arrival counted as digits_before_arrival
conventions.boundaries: charge above charge_domain_pe upper bound clamped to it and counted (overflow_clamped); charge below the domain or wavelength outside the QE table rejected; no extrapolation
conventions.rng: BLAKE2b pmt-v1 keyed by seed/event/persistent photon ID for detection, seed/event/channel for charge, timing and dark counts, and seed/event/(channel, rank) for dark times; dark-noise-only windows add a dark_window:<n> stream namespace
conventions.discriminator: T-Q mode: continuous PE peak, threshold .25 PE; legacy threshold_walk mode retains sampled-template normalization
conventions.per_channel_factors: factor_i = base + odd_group_delta * (group_i mod 2); group = dense mPMT module index on WCTE (D-G), contiguous 12-channel synthetic groups on the fixture
conventions.dark_counts: dark PE join the detected PE before digitisation; one digit per PMT, so a dark PE earlier than the source light sets that digit's time; n_dark_true is evaluation-only truth; dark-noise-only windows use noise_module_lucid.readout.dark_noise_window(params, n_channels, seed=, run=, window=)

threshold_pe.source: J. Xia, Upgrade and Calibration of Super-Kamiokande's Inner Photodetectors, MSc thesis, University of Tokyo, July 2019, section 6.1: Super-K's -0.69 mV threshold corresponds to about 0.25 PE; literature proxy for the 50 cm Super-Kamiokande (R3600) PMT, not a measurement of WCTE's 3-inch PMT; status literature_sk (value unchanged from v2)

walk_calibration_pe.source: synthetic development default; not thesis numerical calibration, not WCTE calibration

spe_sigma.source: J. Xia, Upgrade and Calibration of Super-Kamiokande's Inner Photodetectors, MSc thesis, University of Tokyo, July 2019, section 4.3: HK Box&Line single-photoelectron charge resolution 30.8%; literature proxy for the 20-inch Hyper-Kamiokande Box&Line (R12860) PMT, not a measurement of WCTE's 3-inch PMT; the thesis PDF is cited, not committed; status literature_proxy_hk_20in (value unchanged from v2)

dead_channels.source: synthetic development default; not thesis numerical calibration, not WCTE calibration

mv_per_pe.source: synthetic development default; not thesis numerical calibration, not WCTE calibration

qe_curve.source: J. Xia, Upgrade and Calibration of Super-Kamiokande's Inner Photodetectors, MSc thesis, University of Tokyo, July 2019, section 4.3, Fig. 4.3 (thesis ref. [21]): HK R12860 average quantum efficiency, digitised by the author by eye (about +/-1 percentage point of QE); zero-QE anchors outside 280-700 nm kept from v2; literature proxy for the 20-inch Hyper-Kamiokande Box&Line (R12860) PMT, not a measurement of WCTE's 3-inch PMT; the thesis PDF is cited, not committed

collection_efficiency.source: J. Xia, Upgrade and Calibration of Super-Kamiokande's Inner Photodetectors, MSc thesis, University of Tokyo, July 2019, section 4.2: HK Box&Line collection efficiency over the full 50 cm; peak QE x CE = 0.305 x 0.87 = 0.26535, which matches the HK requirement of 26% (Table 4.1); literature proxy for the 20-inch Hyper-Kamiokande Box&Line (R12860) PMT, not a measurement of WCTE's 3-inch PMT; the thesis PDF is cited, not committed

charge_domain_pe.source: runbook v2 §3 D-Q: one domain [0.25,1000] PE everywhere; overflow clamped and counted

walk.source: runbook v2 §3 D-TQ synthetic default (a=0, b=2 ns, q_sat=50 PE)

timing_width.source: J. Xia, Upgrade and Calibration of Super-Kamiokande's Inner Photodetectors, MSc thesis, University of Tokyo, July 2019, section 6.2 Eq. 6.3, Fig. 6.4(b) and Fig. 6.3 (sigma_r blue = early side, sigma_l magenta = late side), HK PMTs; digitised by the author by eye (about +/-0.1 ns); interpolated linearly in log10 q; the 2 PE bump is kept as measured; the values are read as standard deviations because section 6.2 says they feed Eq. 6.3 (Eq. 6.2 omits the factor 2, so a sqrt(2) re-reading is an open question for Junjie); literature proxy for the 20-inch Hyper-Kamiokande Box&Line (R12860) PMT, not a measurement of WCTE's 3-inch PMT; the thesis PDF is cited, not committed

gain.source: runbook v2 §3 D-G: per-module factor rule on the mPMT map (WCTE) or synthetic groups (fixture); factor values synthetic

timing_width_factor.source: runbook v2 §3 D-G: per-module factor rule on the mPMT map (WCTE) or synthetic groups (fixture); factor values synthetic

dark_rate_hz.source: R-6 (author, 18 Oct 2026): synthetic default 1 kHz per PMT; not a measured WCTE 3-inch PMT dark rate

readout_window_ns.source: R-6 engineering choice: 1 us window around the prompt light (forward ns, event time origin); dark hits are generated uniformly in it; source photons are not cut by it

fixture.geometry: synthetic 76-sensor cylinder toy.cylinder_detector(4, 12, 2), NOT WCTE geometry
fixture.group_source: contiguous fixture channels; NOT physical crates

literature_provenance.citation: J. Xia, Upgrade and Calibration of Super-Kamiokande's Inner Photodetectors, MSc thesis, University of Tokyo, July 2019
literature_provenance.note: cited, not committed; the thesis measures 50 cm Super-K (R3600) and Hyper-K Box&Line (R12860) PMTs, not WCTE's 3-inch PMTs, so every adopted value is a proxy; a WCTE value from Junjie replaces a proxy as soon as it arrives
literature_provenance.open_question: whether the section 6.2 / Fig. 6.3 widths are standard deviations feeding Eq. 6.3 or are off by sqrt(2) because Eq. 6.2 omits the factor 2
